name: guardrails
description: Eleven safety guards that block secret/credential writes, hardcoded machine-specific paths, git hook-bypass attempts, irreversible git operations (force-push, reset --hard, worktree-wide checkout/restore discards), Bash file-write workarounds that circumvent Write/Edit hooks, commit subjects and gh pr create titles that violate the repo's tracked team convention (when one is declared in .claude/source-control.md), (advisory) hallucinated CLI flags, (advisory) /plugin:skill references that do not resolve, (advisory) un-throttled Workflow fan-out that risks burst 529s, and (advisory) direct git commit/gh pr create calls bypassing this marketplace's own commit/pull-request skills — each independently toggleable.

secret_pattern_detection_enabled.title: secret-pattern-detection guard
secret_pattern_detection_enabled.description: Block writes containing high-confidence secret/credential patterns

hardcoded_path_check_enabled.title: hardcoded-path-check guard
hardcoded_path_check_enabled.description: Block writes containing hardcoded machine-specific paths

block_no_verify_enabled.title: block-no-verify guard
block_no_verify_enabled.description: Block git hook-bypass attempts (--no-verify, core.hooksPath=, hook-manager env-var disables for a configurable set — lefthook/husky/pre-commit/simple-git-hooks by default)

block_dangerous_git_enabled.title: block-dangerous-git guard
block_dangerous_git_enabled.description: Block irreversible git operations (push --force, push --force-with-lease leasing against a value git resolves at push time — either no expected value, or an expectation that is not an object id of the repository's own hash width — reset --hard, clean -f, worktree-wide checkout/restore discards)

block_hook_bypass_enabled.title: block-hook-bypass guard
block_hook_bypass_enabled.description: Block Bash file-write workarounds that circumvent Write/Edit hook gates

block_noncanonical_commit_enabled.title: block-noncanonical-commit guard
block_noncanonical_commit_enabled.description: Block `git commit` that does not pipe its message via `-F -`; --amend, -C/-c, --fixup/--squash, -F <path>, and an in-progress merge/rebase are exempt

block_convention_gate_enabled.title: block-convention-violation guard
block_convention_gate_enabled.description: Block a commit subject or `gh pr create --title` that violates the team-tracked convention pattern in .claude/source-control.md (no tracked pattern = no enforcement; same exemptions as block-noncanonical-commit)

cli_flag_verify_enabled.title: cli-flag-verify guard
cli_flag_verify_enabled.description: Advise on hallucinated CLI flags written to files (never blocks)

skill_reference_verify_enabled.title: skill-reference-verify guard
skill_reference_verify_enabled.description: Advise when markdown cites a /plugin:skill reference this repo owns but cannot resolve (never blocks)

workflow_resilience_check_enabled.title: workflow-resilience-check guard
workflow_resilience_check_enabled.description: Advise on un-throttled Workflow fan-out (never blocks)

flag_commit_pr_skill_bypass_enabled.title: flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass guard
flag_commit_pr_skill_bypass_enabled.description: Advise when direct git commit / gh pr create bypasses the source-control skills (never blocks)

cli_flag_verify_bins.title: cli-flag-verify binaries
cli_flag_verify_bins.description: Comma-separated binaries cli-flag-verify scans; empty uses the built-in default set

cli_flag_verify_skip_bins.title: cli-flag-verify skip list
cli_flag_verify_skip_bins.description: Comma-separated binaries cli-flag-verify must never scan

block_dangerous_git_allow.title: block-dangerous-git allow-list
block_dangerous_git_allow.description: Comma-separated forms block-dangerous-git permits: push-force, push-lease-unsafe, reset-hard, clean-force, checkout-dot, restore-dot, checkout-force; empty blocks all

block_noncanonical_commit_allow.title: block-noncanonical-commit allow-list
block_noncanonical_commit_allow.description: Comma-separated form tokens to allow (currently: message-flag, which permits a bare `-m`)

block_no_verify_hook_manager_prefixes.title: block-no-verify hook-manager prefixes
block_no_verify_hook_manager_prefixes.description: Comma-separated hook-manager env-var name prefixes block-no-verify treats as a bypass when set to 0/false (e.g. lefthook,husky); empty uses the built-in default set (lefthook, husky, pre_commit, simple_git_hooks)
